method: two independent transcriptions of the printed table (Claude; Codex gpt-6.2-sol high), compared cell by cell by tools/diff_tables.py, every number exactly as printed; a cell enters only when both agree (status agreed)

columns.quantity: footpad depth d: from the soil surface to the bottom of the pad at zero pitch (Fig. 4-4), a nominal set point held by locking the loading piston (printed 3-13, PDF 154); the pad's ball pivot may have been free or clamped, which is not stated per run (Fig. 3-10)
mean dynamic penetrometer peak deceleration of the bed, g_p bar
bulk density (unit weight under standard gravity)

derived_columns: A_ft is the total horizontal frontal area and A_pt the vertical frontal area of the footpad (labels of Fig. 4-4, printed 4-6, PDF 191; no formula printed); g in V_H/sqrt(dg) is not defined on the page. The arithmetic check is qa/tables-s4-b1/arithmetic.md; rows outside the printed rounding are named in `check`.

audit.rule: the student reviewers check a sample of the printed cells against the scan, each cell for its row and column (A) and its value as printed (B); a cell is confirmed when two reviewers answered ok; `audit` in runs.csv lists each run's audited cells with their outcome; a run's status stays as the two transcriptions left it

precision: each value carries the precision of its printing (half a unit of its last printed digit), except the diameters D and depths d, nominal set points of the rig, taken as exact; no reading bound applies to a transcribed number. The units of F_D/A_ft and F_V/A_pt are not printed; psi is inferred from their magnitudes and the other columns. Printed values are in the columns named by their printed unit (D_in, FD_lb, ...); a column kept as printed (Dr, alpha_deg, the dimensionless derived columns) is not repeated
pending_cells: a cell with an unreadable digit (`?`) keeps it in the printed column, its SI value is empty and its row is pending-review
